original.statement: Traefik's Gateway API provider now handles middlewares referenced through the filters extension reference (an enhancement).

decision.reason: [ev-4aa7e3fe937e] is a changelog Enhancements entry saying the Gateway API provider now handles middlewares referenced through a filter's extension reference. That is a new capability, so "added" is the right change type. The excerpt names no CRD field path, Helm value or flag, so a free-form protocol-behavior subject is the closest family it supports, and the kebab-case name uses only the evidence's own key words. Confidence is low because this is a runtime capability rather than wire-level protocol behaviour, so the family is a weak fit, and the excerpt adds nothing beyond one line.
